title: Figure 3: double-hull vehicle cutaway separating external and internal force environments
description: 3D cutaway rendering of a spherical vehicle with a gold outer shell, blue mesh inner shell and a central grey crew cabin cube, set inside a wireframe box representing the external coordinate system. Callouts label the "Coordinate system of the external environment," "Crew cabin where inertial and gravitational forces are maintained at normal, safe conditions," the outer propulsion shell and the inner protective shell. Captioned "Figure 3. Necessary Distinction Between External and Internal Force Environments. [Graphic: A. Szames]."
